  if true
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      if allow_nil
        return token
      end
      return token.empty? ? nil : token
    end
  end
  if allow_nil
    return token
  end
  if token.empty?
    nil
  else
    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      if allow_nil
        return token
      end
      return token.empty? ? nil : token
    end
  end
  if allow_nil
    return token
  end
  if token.empty?
    nil
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      if allow_nil
        return token
      end
      return token.empty? ? nil : token
    end
  end
  if allow_nil
    return token
  end
  if token.empty?
    nil
  else
    token
  end
end

  return nil

  end

      return stripped

  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)

      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result

      if allow_nil
        return token
      end
      return token.empty? ? nil : token

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: false)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      if allow_nil
        return token
      end
      return token.empty? ? nil : token
    end
  end
  if allow_nil
    return token
  end
  if token.empty?
    nil
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?

    return ""
  end

  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if nil
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result

      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      if allow_nil

      end
      return token.empty? ? nil : token

  end

  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      if allow_nil
        return token
      end
      return token.empty? ? nil : token
    end
  end
  if allow_nil
    return token
  end
  if token.empty?
    nil
  else
    token
  end

      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped

  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = self.render(context)
      if allow_nil

      return token.empty? ? nil : token
